(pha)༄༅/ /gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med rnam rol tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'ji

tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med rnam rol tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'jigs pa med par rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal mchog bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs// gdug pa 'dul phyir gshin rje yi// gshed du gyur la phyag 'tshal nas// de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ 'di sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ stan bde ba la bsdad la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ gnas skabs su bdud dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i don du gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom mo// de nas rang gi snying gi nang du pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po las 'od 'phros pas/ thog mar rang gi lus gang bas sdig pa thams cad sbyangs/ de nas sna'i sgo nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkhar gshin rje gshed dmar po/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pas dbur brgyan pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang*/ shrī sa ma ta rak+ta ya mā ri pā da naṃ ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas/ gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trām̐/ oṃ badz+ra gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dī pi hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ zhes brjod pas/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// la sogs pas yan lag bdun pa lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas tshogs kyi zhing gshegs su gsol nas/ tshad med pa rnam pa bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms la/

oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms la/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shin tu rgya che ba'i steng du/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ dmar po las rdo rje sngon po dang mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar por gyur/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgya che ba'i steng du/ ma he dmar po rwa dang rmig pa sngon po shin tu khros pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa'i steng na gshin rje khas phub tu bsgyel ba'i steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ zhabs g.yas pa bskum pas ma he'i rwa'i bar dang*/ g.yon pa brkyang pas tshang ra'i steng du brdzis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ mi mgo dang bcas pa'i dbyug pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dang*/ dpa' ba dang*/ mi sdug pa dang*/ dgod pa dang*/ drag shul dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ snying rje dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ zhi ba'i gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon pa khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/

skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom mo// gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang gis bsgoms pa dang*/ rjes su mthun pa gshin rje gshed rigs lnga la/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drang*/ de rnams la snga ma bzhin du mchod nas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis ye shes kyi chus bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas/ rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ dbang gi lha de rnams ye shes pa'i tshul gyis rang la gnyis su med par bstim pa dang*/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba dang*/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ dmar po nas 'bras tsam ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' dmigs nas/ yum gyi bha ga pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje rtse mo lnga par bskyed nas/ snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig les yab yum gnyis ka'i sku yongs su gang nas rjes su chags pa las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i bde bas gnyis ka mnyes par byas/

de'i stobs kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gnyis su med pa'i bde bas mnyes/ sems can thams cad kyang sdug bsngal zhi/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas thig le rnams ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pa'i rtser/ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa gnas pas bdag nyid la mchod par bsam zhing*/ gong du brjod pa'i sngags rnams dang*// gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// longs spyod yul du du mar snang*// shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no// 'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la// rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho/ rol du gsol/ gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la// dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod// reg bya 'gag pa med pa la// mig yor bzhin du rol du gsol// ho chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod// ces brjod cing mchod nas/ slar yang de dag nyid kyis/ kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po// bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin// khyod mthong ba na bdag 'jigs te// bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spangs// khyod kyis gar mdzad sa steng dang*// sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo// chags pas brgyan pa khro bo'i yid// gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs gzugs// sku lus sbom thung dmar po ste// rnam pa sna tshogs sku sprul zhing*// rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis 'khyud// gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che// khyod kyi hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rī'i gsang sngags kyis// sa gsum po'i 'khrul pa sel// rje btsun snying rje yis ni khro// gar mdzad 'jig rten khyod gzigs 'dud// ces pas bstod nas/ mchod pa'i lha mo de rnams rang gi snying gar bsdus la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas lha'i sku sems dpa' sum brtsegs de nyid la dmigs la yid mnyam par gzhag go

/bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod na/ gzhan dang mtshungs par bsgoms dang 'gal ba ni med do// 'di'i bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gis ni 'od gsal bsgom pa nyid la gtso bor mdzad do// de'i rim pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la phog cing*/ de rnams bsdus nas gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim/ rang yang thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ yang nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar mi dmigs par gyur nas stong pa nyid 'od gsal ba'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// de nas mnyam gzhag las ldang ba'i tshe/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bdag nyid gshin rje gshed snod bcud thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo'i dkyil 'khor du skad cig gis blta bar bya'o// de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyi rang gi lus kyi nang yongs su gang bas sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas/ phyir 'phros pas bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas de dag gi ye shes dang*/ byin rlabs yig 'bru'i rnam pas spyan drangs pa rang gi snying gar thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so// oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o// de dag ji srid nus kyi bar du bzlas par bya'o// grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ snying po la 'bum phrag bcu bzhi dang*/ nye ba'i snying po la 'bum phrag bdun no// mchog bsgrub pa la ni tshad med do// bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/

bdag nyid gshin rje gshed yab yum dang*/ snang ba thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur bsgoms nas/ oṃ zhes bya ba dang*/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags su bsgoms nas/ āḥzhes bya ba dang*/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul bar bsams la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod nas de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa sgyu ma ltar gsal bar snang la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du lhun gyis grub pa ngo bo zung 'jug tu gnas par shes pas/ lhas lha la mchod par bsam zhing*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la sdang zhen med par longs spyod do// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni 'od gsal la 'jug pa dang 'dra zhing*/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni 'od gsal las ldang ba dang 'dra la/ rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rim gyi skabs kyi bde ba chen po bsgom pa'i tshul dang 'dra ba nyid do// //tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed par 'dod pas/ rten dang nang gi mchod pa dang*/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum dang*/ gzhan yang 'dir mkho ba'i yo byad rnams sta gon byas nas/ rim pa gnyis bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs pa dang*/ yi ge bdun pa'i sngags kyis mchod pa rnams bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge gsum las byung ba'i mchod pa'i rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun du dmigs pa'i rten yod dam/ med kyang rung*/ bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i bcom ldan 'das la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dmigs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa sprul pa rnams kyis/ gong gi mchod rdzas thogs nas mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ta ya mā ri/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās zhal bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog

badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo rnams phul la/ nang gi mchod pa gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtheb srin gyi thor mas phul la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med par gyur pas mchod par bsam zhing*/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon bir+wa pa/ ḍoṃ bi he ru ka dpal 'dzin/ dza ya ri pa/ bī ra ḍi pa/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niṣ+ka laṅka de wa/ ra wan pra bha/ bla ma shes rab rin chen/ zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ yi dam gyi lha rnams la phul nas/ rang gi lce dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg pas lus kyi lha mchod nas/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams la'ang mchod par bya'o// de nas 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad dang*/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas mchod par bsam zhing*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// zhes pa la sogs pas mchod nas/ bdag dang mchod pa'i lha mo nyid kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po// zhes pa la sogs pas bstod nas/ mchod pa'i lha mo de dag tshogs kyi zhing gi thugs kar thim par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma sbyang ba'i dang po yi ge bdun pas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ āḥlas thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ lhor ra las rak+ta dang*/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dang*/

mi mgos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa bskyed nas/ de las 'od 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bzhu nas kha dog dmar zhing reg bya tsha bar gyur/ yang dbyug pa las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs pa dbyug pa dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du babs pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po kha dog dkar zhing*/ reg bya bsil ba/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas gtor ma'i mgron du/ dpal gshin rje gshed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥhaḥbho ma hā kro dha ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ pra sā de pū dzaṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa pra sā daṃ ma di ma naṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ tshogs kyi zhing la gnyis su med par bstim pa'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na rak+ta ya mā ri i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa ma ma bigh+nān ha ra ha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ snga ma bzhin du mchod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab par bya'o// gnyis pa rdo rje nag po chen po la dbul lo// gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong bcu/ nyi zla dang*/ thag zangs risadang*/ khyab 'jug dang bcas pa'i phyogs skyong bcu bzhi spyan drangs la/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor du bskor bar bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu bzhi la phog pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam par gyur pa rnams la gtor ma phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad mngon du byas pa gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs shing*/ nang mchod kyis bran nas/ yo byad rnams bteg pa'am/ bteg par mos la mdun bskyed dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad la phul bar bsam zhing*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// zhes pa la sogs pa lan gsum du brjod do// de nas phud dbul ba dang*/ dam tshig drang ba gzhan dang 'dra la/ phud kyis nang mchod kyi skabs ltar mchod nas/ slar yang rang nyid gshin rje gshed du gsal bar dmigs pa'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me 'bar bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang ba'i snying gar gshin rje gshed/ bla ma rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam pas dbur brgyan pa'i mtha' ma sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong bcu bzhi la 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyi sbyor bas kha hom khung du phul bas/ 'phags pa mchod pa dang*/ sems can tshim par bsam zhing*/ zas la ma zhen par longs spyod do// lhag ma'i gtor ma 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs te/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad mdun du dmigs pa la byin par bsam zhing*/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin nas/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir gsol// zhes shes pa brjod nas/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs la/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog

/ces smon lam btab nas/ rten yod na gshegs su mi gsol zhing*/ med na badz+ra muḥs gtor ma'i mgron dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ las kyi rjes bsdus nas/ rang gi gnas bsrungs la ci bde bar spyad do// mchod pa'i rim pa'o// rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyang gzhan dang 'dra ba nyid do// tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang ma 'brel ba'i kha zas kyi rnal 'byor yang gong du bstan pa'i tshul nyid kyis bya'o// dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas na 'di ltar spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni ring por mi thogs par bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur zhing*/ thun mong gi dngos grub ni zhar las 'grub pa nyid do// dpal 'byor kun mchog bde dang grol ba ste// de yi rtsa ba shes rab kho na yin// 'tshe ba'i mthar thug bdud dang gshin rje ste// de yi rtsa ba ma rig pa las byung*// de phyir zhi bas shes rab skyed byed cing*// khro bar gyur pas nyes pa drungs 'byin pa// 'jam pa'i dpal dang dpal mgon gshin rje gshed// zhi dang khro dang gnyis ka zung 'jug tu// thub pa nyid kyis rnam par 'phrul pa gang*// gdul bya 'phags pa'i skyes mchog las brgyud nas// brgyud pa mchog nas mchog la brgyud gyur te// kun gyi byin brlabs man ngag la 'bab cing*// de yang de 'drar mkhyen pa'i mkhyen bzang zhing*// de sogs de 'drar 'dun pa'i 'dun pa can// jim gyim gyis ni rgyal la rgyal sras bzhin// bdag la bskul nas bskul bzhin bdag gis sbyar// sbyar ba'i dge dang dge ba de las gzhan// gzhan dang bdag gis bdag gir byas pa gang*// gang yod de yis de dang de dag kun// kun mkhyen kun bzang kun nas thob gyur cig /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jigs pa med par rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen glo bo lo tsā ba las thob pa dang*/

thos pa bzhin dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pa zhes bya bas sa mo sbrul gyi lo dpyid zla ra ba la cong to'i pho brang sar pa'i dag byed khrus khang gi gling du sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
